claims.claim: OpenAI's o1-preview with AIDE scaffolding achieves at least the level of a Kaggle bronze medal in 16.9% of MLE-bench competitions.
claims.quote: finding that the best-performing setup--OpenAI's o1-preview with AIDE scaffolding--achieves at least the level of a Kaggle bronze medal in 16.9% of competitions.

claims.claim: Claude v3 Opus builds compelling ML models over many MLAgentBench tasks with 37.5% average success rate.
claims.quote: It can build compelling ML models over many tasks in MLAgentBench with 37.5% average success rate.

claims.claim: The best pairing of search strategy and operator set increases Kaggle medal success rate from 39.6% to 47.7% on MLE-bench lite.
claims.quote: Our best pairing of search strategy and operator set achieves a state-of-the-art result on MLE-bench lite, increasing the success rate of achieving a Kaggle medal from 39.6% to 47.7%.

claims.claim: MLE-STAR achieves medals in 64% of Kaggle competitions on MLE-bench Lite.
claims.quote: Our experimental results show that MLE-STAR achieves medals in 64% of the Kaggle competitions on the MLE-bench Lite.
